scope: Minimal integration of actual eight hosted CI failures; no skips/exclusions/floor changes, product or workflow changes.
unchangedDemoEvidence: artifacts/streaming/demo/final/mode-provider-equivalence.json + delivery-manifest.json; eight actual same-project JIT/AOT x PG/SQLite x runtime10/11 executions are reused, not rerun.

contracts.oldIntent: Every public Query parameter type is reviewed and no unreviewed string identifier surface appears.
contracts.newProperty: Keep exact reflected set comparison and string roster; add only CancellationToken for the four neutral streaming entry points.

contracts.oldIntent: Every emitted file has only one generated header, no other comments or tracker cites, and no SQL text.
contracts.newProperty: Pin exact six fixture hint names and one header per file; retain whole-output no-comment/no-tracker/no-SQL assertions.

contracts.oldIntent: Entity generation is deterministic under syntax-tree reordering and uses ordinal entity order.
contracts.newProperty: Compare the complete ordered hint/text tuple arrays; pin exact four hints and Alpha/Beta isolation/order rather than selecting a nonexistent monolith.

contracts.oldIntent: Every statement terminal actually executes and preserves query rendering/state, including supported row locks.
contracts.newProperty: Add all four stream entries to real execution rows, drain to EOF and require typed Completion cleanup via existing collector. Locked streams borrow a real UnitOfWork; all four join the native PG lock rows. No new exclusion.

contracts.oldIntent: Every public root-read path executes both live-only and IncludingDeleted visibility cases.
contracts.newProperty: Compose all old paths with four typed stream paths; same exact reflected-name equality, ordered expected live/deleted ranks and Completion checks remain.

contracts.oldIntent: Every surveyed statement-producing method has an actual case; stale exclusions fail.
contracts.newProperty: Register four executed stream transcript cases with nonempty exact row expectations, parameterized SQL, cold no-command assertion and Completion checks. Direct capture-getter assertions cover exact source/provider/map/borrowed/lock metadata; no exclusions added.

contracts.oldIntent: Byte-exact generated/SQL/semantic transcripts, complete hint set, no orphan goldens and deterministic capture.
contracts.newProperty: Fresh capture pins complete per-type generated files. Only generated C# layout outputs, newly executed streaming transcripts and derived INDEX may differ; every old nongenerated SQL/schema/registry/Init execution transcript must stay byte-exact. Existing normal comparison/determinism tests remain intact and regeneration is unset for verification.

staleExclusionRemoval.oldIntent: Exclude a non-statement cleanup API while no registered corpus case calls it.
staleExclusionRemoval.newCorrectProperty: New registered streaming cases actually await context disposal. Remove the now-stale exclusion, preserving the existing guard that forbids exclusions for referenced members.
staleExclusionRemoval.observedGuard: First normal capture exit3 explicitly named stale exclusion; no case/namespace filters were weakened.
